comparison.objective: Pushes a hose fully onto a barb and tightens a worm-drive clamp; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1892 requires axial hose seating, clamp placement, socket engagement, and driver regrasping; the candidate requires simultaneous counterrotation of a screw and jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1892 checks hose depth, clamp location, snug/tight state, and released clearance; the candidate checks retained opening angle and repeated articulated operation.
comparison.reason: Generic screw turning is insufficient overlap; hose insertion and circumferential clamping do not test preservation of a coupled adjuster setting.

review_notes: Own-team accepted hose+barb+clamp. Compare tool turning/clamping versus preserving coupled screw setting while locking and functional cycling. Generic screw turning alone insufficient novelty. Full source attached.
